Title: General availability: Azure SQL Database Query Performance

Body.Content: Azure SQL Database Query Performance Insight helps you understand the impact of your query workload on database resource consumption. In minutes, you can monitor how your apps utilize your database’s resources and implement actions to tune your database or application. Getting started is easy and fast—it takes only a couple of clicks. Query Performance Insight shows you the CPU consumption of your top queries over time, with drilldowns to the level of query text. This helps you discover potential performance issues quickly and resolve them before your customers are affected. For more information about Query Performance Insight, visit the Azure SQL Database Query Performance Insight documentation page.
